Parking is governed retained custody, not a withdrawal or guarantee against malicious/unavailable immutable core dependencies.
Entry uses actual original source valuation and one shared 99% LP floor; verified routes/feeds and actual Pons stable-source fork rehearsal remain release gates.
Test references identify source coverage; execution receipts and production approval are separate.
